title: Issue [3]: runOnce: false Reruns Without Prereq Dedupe
summary: A dependent config with runOnce: false can spawn duplicate jobs on every idle reconcile after its own job is Finished, because shouldCreateJob treats rerun as a static flag check — not as "prereq completed again since last run."
meta: Source: reviewV2-bugs.md MAJOR [3] · Open bug (no fix in tree at analysis time) · kairos-tenant-job-runner
footer: Generated 2026-07-15. Inspected: reviewV2-bugs.md [3], manager.go (shouldCreateJob, preconditionsAllowCreation), preconditions.go, jobstatus_controller.go (triggerDependentConfigs), api/v1/tenantjobconfiguration.go, preconditions_test.go, manager/preconditions_test.go, integration manifests 56 and scenario 52. Assumption: no fix committed yet.

blocks.content:
Mental model

jobPreconditions order work: config deploy waits until config build has a finished normal job. Each entry in the list can set runOnce:

rows: Dependent runs once per job version when prereq completes; no rerun when prereq finishes again for the same version
Each new successful prereq completion may create another dependent job
blocks.caption: From api/v1/tenantjobconfiguration.go JobPrecondition.RunOnce comment.

blocks.content: Two mechanisms can wake the dependent config:

cards.title: Event-driven
cards.content: JobStatusReconciler.triggerDependentConfigs enqueues dependents when a prereq K8s job reaches Finished.

cards.title: Periodic
cards.content: Manager Reconcile runs on a work queue timer / resync for every tenant+config.

blocks.content:
Dedupe for "already ran this version"

GetMatchingJob finds the newest row for the same config_name, template_name, template_generation, config_hash, and is_deleting. If that row is Finished, shouldCreateJob normally returns false — unless a rerun policy says otherwise.

Toy scenario

Prereq build and dependent deploy. Dependent has runOnce: false on the prereq entry. Both have stable jobVersion / config hash.

  1. Build finishes → deploy creates job #1 → deploy finishes.
  2. Periodic reconcile runs again (no new build completion).

panels.title: Intended
panels.content: No new deploy job. Prereq did not complete again.

panels.title: Actual (bug)
panels.content: shouldCreateJob returns true → deploy job #2, #3, … on subsequent reconciles while the latest matching row stays Finished.

blocks.content: AllowsRerunWhenFinished scans config: "does any entry have runOnce: false?" It does not compare the prereq's latest job id or finished_at against what already triggered a dependent rerun.

blocks.title: Misleading log reason
blocks.content: The reason string says rerunFinished policy even when the trigger was runOnce: false on a precondition — same branch, shared message.

When the intended path works

Integration scenario 52 bumps prereq jobVersion v1→v2. That creates a second prereq job; when it finishes, triggerDependentConfigs enqueues deploy and a second deploy job is expected. The test asserts job counts after that explicit bump — not after idle resyncs.

blocks.caption: Bug reconcile loop when periodic resync runs after deploy already Finished.

blocks.code:
// RunOnce when true (default) prevents re-triggering ...
// When false, each successful prerequisite completion may create a new job.

blocks.content:
No repository call; no memory of last triggering prereq job.

3. Rerun branch — shouldCreateJob

internal/jobs/manager/manager.go (~lines 832–856)

Called from createJobIfNeeded after preconditionsAllowCreation already returned true (prereq Finished → Satisfied).

4. Event path — triggerDependentConfigs

internal/controller/jobstatus_controller.go (~lines 487–518)

On prereq Finished, lists all configs in namespace and enqueues any that ReferencesConfig the completed config. Does not check runOnce here — gating happens later in shouldCreateJob.

For runOnce: true, event enqueue + shouldCreateJob → false when matching job already Finished. Correct.

For runOnce: false, event path is correct; periodic path is the leak.

5. Tests today

rows: runOnce: false + matching Finished → needs new job
Encodes the buggy predicate, not dedupe
Second deploy job after prereq jobVersion bump

blocks.content:
6. Suggested fix directions (review)

  • Persist trigger cursor: store last prereq job id (or finished_at) that caused a dependent rerun; in shouldCreateJob, only rerun if prereq's latest finished job is newer.
  • Document as intentional: if product accepts rerun-on-every-reconcile, fix API text and reason string (unlikely given field semantics).
  • Separate reason strings for RerunFinished vs precondition rerun.

blocks.title: Status
blocks.content: This is an open MAJOR per review V2. No dedupe implementation was found in the codebase at analysis time.

quiz.question: According to the API comment, when should runOnce: false create another dependent job?
quiz.explain: The field documents event-based rerun per prereq completion, not periodic reconcile.
quiz.distractors: Every reconcile is the bug. Hash change is a separate generation path. runOnce false enables rerun, not blocking.

options.text: On every manager reconcile while the dependent job is Finished
Only when the prerequisite completes successfully again
Only when the dependent config hash changes
Never; runOnce false disables all deduplication

quiz.question: What does AllowsRerunWhenFinished actually check?
quiz.explain: It is a static scan of the precondition list — no DB comparison.
quiz.distractors: Prereq timing and Satisfied state are handled elsewhere. RerunFinished is a separate OR branch in shouldCreateJob.

options.text: Whether the prerequisite job finished since the last dependent run
Whether OnUpdate.RerunFinished is true on the dependent config
Whether all prerequisites are in Finished status right now
Whether any jobPrecondition entry has runOnce set to false

quiz.question: Dependent deploy is Finished (same version). Prereq has not run again. runOnce: false. Next idle reconcile — shouldCreateJob?
quiz.explain: matchingJob Finished + AllowsRerunWhenFinished true → create again. preconditionsAllowCreation still passes because prereq remains Finished.
quiz.distractors: The intended false outcome is not implemented. Preconditions gate unsatisfied/waiting, not this dedupe gap.

options.text: Returns true; may insert another deploy job (bug)
Returns false; no matching rerun signal
Returns false; preconditionsAllowCreation blocks first
Panics because runOnce false is invalid with Finished jobs

quiz.question: When does triggerDependentConfigs enqueue dependent configs?
quiz.explain: JobStatusReconciler calls it after terminal update to Finished; it lists configs referencing the completed config name.
quiz.distractors: runOnce is not checked in the controller; shouldCreateJob applies it later. Matching job nil is the first-create path, not this trigger.

options.text: When any config in the namespace is reconciled
When a prerequisite K8s job reaches Finished status
Only when runOnce is false on the dependent entry
Only when the dependent matching job is nil

quiz.question: Why can integration scenario 52 pass while MAJOR [3] remains valid?
quiz.explain: Scenario 52 validates the happy event path (prereq runs twice → deploy runs twice). It does not wait for periodic reconciles without a new prereq completion.
quiz.distractors: No prereq id dedupe exists. AllowsRerunWhenFinished is still in preconditions.go.

options.text: shouldCreateJob dedupes by prereq job id internally
The test drives a second prereq run via jobVersion bump and does not check idle resync spam
runOnce false is ignored in production builds
AllowsRerunWhenFinished was removed after the test was written
